sentences.text: Parasutterella excrementihominis is a strictly anaerobic, non-spore-forming, Gram-negative coccobacillus of the family Alcaligenaceae that was isolated from human faeces.
The type strain is asaccharolytic and largely unreactive biochemically, with a trace amount of propionate detected as an end product of metabolism.
The genus Parasutterella has been defined as a core component of the human and mouse gut microbiota, and mouse, rat and human isolates were all asaccharolytic producers of succinate.

A study reported Parasutterella abundance differing in irritable bowel syndrome and related to chronic intestinal inflammation, and a systematic review listed the genus among those higher in major depression.
